_comment: Pre-seeded records for get_case_status/create_support_ticket testing (Week 4). Read-only seed — src/tools/mock_db.py copies this into the mutable runtime store on first use / reset. One record per (category x status) combination that the catalogue's output schema defines, so every enum value in docs/architecture/University_Student_Support_Case_Agent_Week4_Tool_Catalogue.pdf has at least one real example to retrieve.
